title: Lia´s Texture Pack
description: My first Texture Pack specialized for PvP in general, simple and not at the same time.
body:
# Lia´s PvP Texture Pack

 My first Texture Pack specialized for PvP in general.

⚠️WARNING⚠️

> **Combine textures from other texture packs, credits go to their respective creators.**

## Features💡

- Low Fire
- Short Swords
- Small Items
- Low Shield
- Small Totems 

###  Version/Compability ✅

> The only version available is **1.20.4**, in the future I will release new updates to current versions.
